description: Assign contact properties to existing contacts. All contacts with a contact model that recognizes the specified property are affected. This command modifies properties of existing contacts directly, unlike CMAT commands which define rules for future contact creation. Property inheritance may also be modified with the optional 'inheritance' keyword. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered.

methods.description: Set a single property value on a contact object

notes: Python SDK requires iteration over contacts - cannot set properties for all contacts in one call
Command interface is more efficient for bulk property updates
Use range specification in command interface to avoid iterating in Python

6.0: Live 6.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself. The property slot enumerates the union of all contact models' property names (~164 keywords on 6.00); per-model membership lives in the contact-models reference.
7.0: Live 7.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself. The property slot enumerates the union of all contact models' property names (~164 keywords on 7.00, including the mc-prefixed mohr set); per-model membership lives in the contact-models reference.
9.0: Live 9.7 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>' / 'contact fluid <sub>' - fluid is 9.x-new); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself. The property slot enumerates the union of all contact models' property names (~308 keywords on 9.7); per-model membership lives in the contact-models reference.

examples.command: contact property pb_kn 1e7 pb_ks 1e7 pb_ten 4e5 pb_coh 4e5 pb_fa 20.0
examples.description: Set parallel bond properties for all contacts with linearpbond model (from fragmentation analysis example) (model: linearpbond).

examples.command: contact property lin_mode 1 lin_force 0 0 0 pb_ten 2e5 pb_coh 2e6
examples.description: Set linear mode, reset force, and update bond strengths (from sleeved triaxial test) (model: linearpbond).

examples.command: contact property pb_ten 1e5 pb_coh 1e5 pb_kn 500 pb_ks 188 pb_rmul 0.8
examples.description: Set bond properties including radius multiplier (from cantilever beam example) (model: linearpbond).
Update stiffnesses and friction for all contacts with linear model (model: linear).
Change friction coefficient only for contacts in 'soil' group (model: any).
Add/update damping ratios for contacts with dashpot properties (model: linear, linearpbond, linearcbond, etc.).

examples.command: contact property hz_shear 2e9 hz_poiss 0.25 range contact type 'ball-ball'
examples.description: Update Hertz model material properties for ball-ball contacts (model: hertz).
Set rolling friction coefficient for all contacts with rrlinear model (model: rrlinear).
Set normal stiffness and enable inheritance from contacting pieces (model: linear, linearpbond, linearcbond).
